notes:
Mapping view: the flow next to the screens its steps map to, with the mapped element highlighted and the scope said in words.

**Layout.** Sub-bar (`size.bar-sub`): back to the detail, use case title, variant picker (`uc-filter-chip`, "Base"; only when the use case has variants), legend Element (outline + dot) · Whole screen (thick tinted) · Stale (dashed). Left: flow list 340px, one row per step: avatar sm, "n · action", `uc-target-chip` (capped at the row width, label ellipsizes); selected step = active fill + 3px accent inset bar (step 3 here); data change as one line ("Mapping: node → btn-mapping, scope screen → element"); generated id → warning line "Generated node id — unstable after a rewrite."; stale → warning box "The screen usecases-editor was removed or renamed. Mappings are never rewritten automatically." (stale node: "The element <id> is gone from <screen>. …") with **Pick new target** (→ step target picker in `usecases-edit-dialog`) and **Leave unmapped** (toast "Step left unmapped."). A step without target shows "Not mapped". Right: canvas, scrolls horizontally. No mapped step at all → canvas text "No step of this use case is mapped to a screen yet." + button **Edit steps**.

**Frames.** One frame per **distinct screen**, in order of first use; a screen used by several steps is rendered once with several pins (usecases-detail carries steps 1 and 5). Frames are live renders of the mapped screens in sandboxed iframes (the drawing uses block mocks); desktop screens render 420px wide (drawn 340 to fit), phone screens 240. **Every frame label** shows the step numbers (`uc-frame-no`), the screen id and one `uc-scope-chip` per scope present: Element / Screen / Stale / Unstable.

**Loading.** Until a frame's render arrives, its box is a plain `chrome-field` fill at the final size (240×384, or the wide size once known) with no pins; pins and outlines appear after the frame is measured. A failed render shows the server message inside the frame in danger colour.

**Highlight language (`uc-pin`).**
- Element: 2px accent outline + light tint over the node + numbered pin on its top-left corner.
- Whole screen: the whole frame gets a 3px accent border and a 14% accent tint, the step number top-right and a "Whole screen" chip bottom-left.
- Unstable (generated node id): dashed outline.
- Stale node on an existing screen: no outline, a dashed warning pin in the frame's top-right corner (`uc-pin missing`; not drawn here).
- Stale screen: dashed amber frame "Screen not found — 1 step points at a screen that no longer exists in this project.", struck screen id, Stale chip.
- The selected step is shown on its **frame label** (primary filled bar, its number in accent) and a soft ring on its pin — never as an outline around the frame, because an outline reads as screen scope.

**Interactions.** Click a step → select it, scroll its frame into view. Click a frame → open that screen in the Screens tab (`app-shell`; Inspect on the node for element scope; flow edges `fr-detail`, `fr-dialog`). The missing-screen frame has no target. Hover a pin → tooltip with node id and tag.
